summary: [spec fidelity] the stateless stage (domains, constraints, validators) is not part of batch preflight for the checks that carry the command's own code: `finding add --input '[{seq 21 note},{seq 22 blocker, no introduced-*}]'` writes item 0 and then fails item 1 with exit 1 BATCH_INCOMPLETE/FINDING_INTRODUCED_REQUIRED, and `[{good},{round 0}]` writes item 0 and fails with FINDING_INVALID_ARGUMENT, while the same faults with a parser-coded domain (`change` Bad_Id) are refused in preflight with exit 2 and nothing written; spec 10.8.3 says a validator reads no state so in a batch it is part of preflight, and 11.11 says preflight is steps 1-6 for every item and a preflight failure exits 2 before any item executes; the brief puts the validators before any state read for every call; blast radius: every batch command with command-coded rules, domains or validators (finding add/close, divergence add/defer, evidence add/audit, review scenario/change, dispatch begin): a later item's stateless fault is found only after earlier items wrote; the single-call sweeps of tests/arg_rules.rs and atip.constraints.18 never submit a batch
